import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, json
root='/workspace/submission'
files=[]
for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):
    for f in fn:
        p=os.path.join(dp,f)
        files.append(p)
        assert os.path.isfile(p) and not os.path.islink(p), p
        name=os.path.basename(p)
        assert name not in ('.','..')
        assert all(32 <= ord(c) < 127 and c not in '\\/' for c in name), name
total=sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p in files)
print('files:', len(files), 'total bytes:', total)
data=open(root+'/main.py','rb').read()
data.decode('utf-8'); print('main.py utf-8 ok, ascii:', all(b<128 for b in data))
# mimic the verifier: private temp cwd, -I, pipe stdin
payload=open('/workspace/examples/requests.jsonl','rb').read()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',os.path.join(root,'main.py')], cwd=cwd,
                     input=payload, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
exp=[json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/examples/expected.jsonl')]
got=[json.loads(l) for l in r.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
print('verifier-style run rc=%d match=%s stderr=%r' % (r.returncode, got==exp, r.stderr[:200]))
PYEOF
